response:
下面给最简可行 v1.1.1 安装器方案。目标不是商业发布，不做签名、不做复杂 GUI、不做自动更新，只做到：
别人拿到一个 PHS_Setup.exe→ 双击→ 自动解压到本机→ 桌面生成 PHS Launcher→ 点 Launcher 可 Doctor / Smoke / Full / OBS

0. 最简方案结论
采用：
PyInstaller 单文件自解压安装器+ 内嵌 payload.zip+ 便携 Python 3.12+ PHS Launcher Tkinter GUI
最终产物：
dist/PHS_Setup_v1.1.1.exe
安装后目录：
%LOCALAPPDATA%\PrismHopeStudio\ app\ _bundled\ ffmpeg\ libvips\ runtime\ piper_models\ scripts\ _runtime\ python\ python.exe PHS_Launcher.py PHS_Launcher.bat runs\ reports\

1. 推荐项目结构
在 D:\PHS 下新增：
tools\ make_payload.py phs_setup.py build_setup.batlauncher\ PHS_Launcher.py
根目录准备：
_runtime\ python\ python.exe python312.dll Lib\ DLLs\ Scripts\ site-packages\
说明：
_runtime/python 是便携 Python 3.12。v1.1.1 不要求用户自己安装 Python。

2. PHS Launcher 代码
保存为：
launcher/PHS_Launcher.py
Pythonimport osimport sysimport jsonimport timeimport queueimport shutilimport threadingimport subprocessfrom pathlib import Pathimport tkinter as tkfrom tkinter import ttk, messagebox, filedialogAPP_NAME = "Prism Hope Studio"VERSION = "v1.1.1"def app_root() -> Path: return Path(__file__).resolve().parentROOT = app_root()PYTHON_EXE = ROOT / "_runtime" / "python" / "python.exe"FFMPEG_BIN = ROOT / "_bundled" / "ffmpeg" / "bin"LIBVIPS_BIN = ROOT / "_bundled" / "libvips" / "bin"PIPER_DIR = ROOT / "runtime" / "piper_models"REPORTS_DIR = ROOT / "reports"RUNS_DIR = ROOT / "runs"def ensure_dirs(): REPORTS_DIR.mkdir(exist_ok=True) RUNS_DIR.mkdir(exist_ok=True)def build_env(): env = os.environ.copy() path_parts = [ str(FFMPEG_BIN), str(LIBVIPS_BIN), str(ROOT), env.get("PATH", ""), ] env["PATH"] = os.pathsep.join(path_parts) env["PHS_ROOT"] = str(ROOT) env["PHS_FFMPEG_BIN"] = str(FFMPEG_BIN) env["PHS_LIBVIPS_BIN"] = str(LIBVIPS_BIN) env["PHS_PIPER_MODELS"] = str(PIPER_DIR) return envclass PHSLauncher(tk.Tk): def __init__(self): super().__init__() self.title(f"{APP_NAME} Launcher {VERSION}") self.geometry("900x620") self.minsize(800, 520) ensure_dirs() self.log_queue = queue.Queue() self.current_process = None self._build_ui() self._poll_log_queue() def _build_ui(self): top = ttk.Frame(self, padding=12) top.pack(fill="x") title = ttk.Label( top, text=f"{APP_NAME} {VERSION}", font=("Segoe UI", 18, "bold") ) title.pack(anchor="w") subtitle = ttk.Label( top, text="免费带货直播素材智能中控 · 本地运行 · OBS 外部连接", font=("Segoe UI", 10) ) subtitle.pack(anchor="w", pady=(4, 0)) status_frame = ttk.LabelFrame(self, text="环境状态", padding=10) status_frame.pack(fill="x", padx=12, pady=(4, 8)) self.status_text = tk.StringVar(value="未检测") ttk.Label(status_frame, textvariable=self.status_text).pack(anchor="w") btn_frame = ttk.Frame(self, padding=12) btn_frame.pack(fill="x") buttons = [ ("环境自检 Doctor", self.run_doctor), ("运行 Smoke 测试", self.run_smoke), ("运行 Full Pipeline", self.run_full), ("启动 OBS/PHS 桥接", self.start_obs_phs), ("打开安装目录", self.open_install_dir), ("打开 reports", self.open_reports), ("停止当前任务", self.stop_process), ] for i, (text, cmd) in enumerate(buttons): btn = ttk.Button(btn_frame, text=text, command=cmd) btn.grid(row=i // 4, column=i % 4, padx=6, pady=6, sticky="ew") for col in range(4): btn_frame.columnconfigure(col, weight=1) log_frame = ttk.LabelFrame(self, text="运行日志", padding=8) log_frame.pack(fill="both", expand=True, padx=12, pady=(0, 12)) self.log = tk.Text(log_frame, wrap="word", font=("Consolas", 10)) self.log.pack(side="left", fill="both", expand=True) scrollbar = ttk.Scrollbar(log_frame, command=self.log.yview) scrollbar.pack(side="right", fill="y") self.log.configure(yscrollcommand=scrollbar.set) self.after(300, self.quick_check) def quick_check(self): checks = [] checks.append(("Python", PYTHON_EXE.exists())) checks.append(("FFmpeg", (FFMPEG_BIN / "ffmpeg.exe").exists())) checks.append(("FFprobe", (FFMPEG_BIN / "ffprobe.exe").exists())) checks.append(("libvips", LIBVIPS_BIN.exists())) checks.append(("Piper models", PIPER_DIR.exists())) checks.append(("run_pipeline", (ROOT / "app" / "material_engine" / "cli" / "run_pipeline.py").exists())) ok = all(v for _, v in checks) parts = [f"{name}: {'OK' if v else 'MISS'}" for name, v in checks] self.status_text.set(" | ".join(parts)) if ok: self.write_log("[OK] 基础运行环境完整。\n") else: self.write_log("[WARN] 有依赖缺失，请运行 Doctor 查看详情。\n") def write_log(self, text: str): self.log.insert("end", text) self.log.see("end") def enqueue_log(self, text: str): self.log_queue.put(text) def _poll_log_queue(self): try: while True: text = self.log_queue.get_nowait() self.write_log(text) except queue.Empty: pass self.after(100, self._poll_log_queue) def run_command(self, name: str, cmd: list[str]): if self.current_process and self.current_process.poll() is None: messagebox.showwarning("任务正在运行", "当前已有任务运行，请先停止。") return self.write_log(f"\n========== {name} ==========\n") self.write_log("命令： " + " ".join(cmd) + "\n\n") def worker(): try: env = build_env() self.current_process = subprocess.Popen( cmd, cwd=str(ROOT), env=env, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, text=True, encoding="utf-8", errors="replace", creationflags=subprocess.CREATE_NO_WINDOW if os.name == "nt" else 0, ) for line in self.current_process.stdout: self.enqueue_log(line) code = self.current_process.wait() self.enqueue_log(f"\n[{name}] 退出码：{code}\n") except Exception as e: self.enqueue_log(f"\n[ERROR] {name} 失败：{e}\n") finally: self.current_process = None threading.Thread(target=worker, daemon=True).start() def run_doctor(self): doctor_py = ROOT / "scripts" / "phs_doctor.py" doctor_ps1 = ROOT / "scripts" / "phs_doctor.ps1" if doctor_py.exists(): cmd = [str(PYTHON_EXE), str(doctor_py)] elif doctor_ps1.exists(): cmd = [ "powershell", "-ExecutionPolicy", "Bypass", "-File", str(doctor_ps1), ] else: self.write_log("[ERROR] 未找到 scripts/phs_doctor.py 或 scripts/phs_doctor.ps1\n") return self.run_command("PHS Doctor", cmd) def run_smoke(self): run_pipeline = ROOT / "app" / "material_engine" / "cli" / "run_pipeline.py" if not run_pipeline.exists(): self.write_log("[ERROR] 未找到 run_pipeline.py\n") return cmd = [ str(PYTHON_EXE), str(run_pipeline), "--mode", "smoke", ] self.run_command("Smoke Test", cmd) def run_full(self): run_pipeline = ROOT / "app" / "material_engine" / "cli" / "run_pipeline.py" if not run_pipeline.exists(): self.write_log("[ERROR] 未找到 run_pipeline.py\n") return input_dir = filedialog.askdirectory( title="选择素材输入目录", initialdir=str(ROOT) ) if not input_dir: return output_dir = RUNS_DIR / f"full_{time.strftime('%Y%m%d_%H%M%S')}" output_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True) cmd = [ str(PYTHON_EXE), str(run_pipeline), "--mode", "full", "--input", str(input_dir), "--output", str(output_dir), ] self.run_command("Full Pipeline", cmd) def start_obs_phs(self): ps1 = ROOT / "scripts" / "start_obs_phs.ps1" py = ROOT / "scripts" / "start_obs_phs.py" if py.exists(): cmd = [str(PYTHON_EXE), str(py)] elif ps1.exists(): cmd = [ "powershell", "-ExecutionPolicy", "Bypass", "-File", str(ps1), ] else: self.write_log("[ERROR] 未找到 scripts/start_obs_phs.py 或 scripts/start_obs_phs.ps1\n") return self.run_command("Start OBS/PHS Bridge", cmd) def stop_process(self): if self.current_process and self.current_process.poll() is None: self.current_process.terminate() self.write_log("\n[INFO] 已请求停止当前任务。\n") else: self.write_log("\n[INFO] 当前没有运行中的任务。\n") def open_install_dir(self): os.startfile(str(ROOT)) def open_reports(self): REPORTS_DIR.mkdir(exist_ok=True) os.startfile(str(REPORTS_DIR))if __name__ == "__main__": app = PHSLauncher() app.mainloop()

3. 自解压安装器代码
保存为：
tools/phs_setup.py
这个安装器做 5 件事：
1. 找到内嵌 payload.zip2. 解压到 %LOCALAPPDATA%\PrismHopeStudio3. 创建 Launcher bat4. 创建桌面快捷方式 bat5. 可选启动 Launcher
Pythonimport osimport sysimport zipfileimport shutilimport subprocessfrom pathlib import Pathimport tkinter as tkfrom tkinter import ttk, messageboxAPP_NAME = "Prism Hope Studio"VERSION = "v1.1.1"INSTALL_DIR = Path(os.environ.get("LOCALAPPDATA", str(Path.home()))) / "PrismHopeStudio"def resource_path(relative: str) -> Path: """ 兼容 PyInstaller: - 开发模式：当前目录 - 打包后：sys._MEIPASS """ if hasattr(sys, "_MEIPASS"): return Path(sys._MEIPASS) / relative return Path(__file__).resolve().parent / relativePAYLOAD_ZIP = resource_path("phs_payload.zip")class Installer(tk.Tk): def __init__(self): super().__init__() self.title(f"{APP_NAME} Setup {VERSION}") self.geometry("620x360") self.resizable(False, False) self.progress_var = tk.DoubleVar(value=0) self.status_var = tk.StringVar(value="准备安装") self._build_ui() def _build_ui(self): frame = ttk.Frame(self, padding=20) frame.pack(fill="both", expand=True) ttk.Label( frame, text=f"{APP_NAME} {VERSION}", font=("Segoe UI", 18, "bold") ).pack(anchor="w") ttk.Label( frame, text="最简自解压安装器 · 安装到当前用户目录 · OBS 需用户自行安装", font=("Segoe UI", 10) ).pack(anchor="w", pady=(6, 18)) install_path = ttk.Label( frame, text=f"安装目录：{INSTALL_DIR}", wraplength=560 ) install_path.pack(anchor="w", pady=(0, 12)) self.progress = ttk.Progressbar( frame, orient="horizontal", mode="determinate", variable=self.progress_var, maximum=100, length=560 ) self.progress.pack(anchor="w", pady=(0, 10)) ttk.Label(frame, textvariable=self.status_var).pack(anchor="w") btn_frame = ttk.Frame(frame) btn_frame.pack(fill="x", pady=(28, 0)) self.install_btn = ttk.Button( btn_frame, text="开始安装", command=self.install ) self.install_btn.pack(side="left") ttk.Button( btn_frame, text="退出", command=self.destroy ).pack(side="right") def set_status(self, text: str, progress: float | None = None): self.status_var.set(text) if progress is not None: self.progress_var.set(progress) self.update_idletasks() def install(self): self.install_btn.configure(state="disabled") try: if not PAYLOAD_ZIP.exists(): raise FileNotFoundError(f"未找到 payload: {PAYLOAD_ZIP}") self.set_status("正在准备安装目录...", 5) INSTALL_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True) self.set_status("正在解压 PHS 文件，首次安装可能需要几分钟...", 10) self.extract_zip(PAYLOAD_ZIP, INSTALL_DIR) self.set_status("正在创建启动脚本...", 85) self.create_launcher_bat() self.set_status("正在创建桌面快捷方式...", 92) self.create_desktop_shortcut() self.set_status("安装完成。", 100) if messagebox.askyesno("安装完成", "PHS 已安装完成，是否现在启动 Launcher？"): self.start_launcher() except Exception as e: messagebox.showerror("安装失败", str(e)) self.set_status(f"安装失败：{e}") finally: self.install_btn.configure(state="normal") def extract_zip(self, zip_path: Path, target_dir: Path): with zipfile.ZipFile(zip_path, "r") as z: members = z.infolist() total = max(len(members), 1) for i, member in enumerate(members): z.extract(member, target_dir) if i % 20 == 0: progress = 10 + (i / total) * 72 self.set_status(f"正在解压：{member.filename}", progress) def create_launcher_bat(self): launcher_py = INSTALL_DIR / "PHS_Launcher.py" python_exe = INSTALL_DIR / "_runtime" / "python" / "python.exe" launcher_bat = INSTALL_DIR / "PHS_Launcher.bat" content = f"""@echo offcd /d "{INSTALL_DIR}""{python_exe}" "{launcher_py}"pause""" launcher_bat.write_text(content, encoding="utf-8") def create_desktop_shortcut(self): desktop = Path(os.environ.get("USERPROFILE", str(Path.home()))) / "Desktop" shortcut_bat = desktop / "PHS Launcher.bat" launcher_bat = INSTALL_DIR / "PHS_Launcher.bat" content = f"""@echo offcall "{launcher_bat}"""" shortcut_bat.write_text(content, encoding="utf-8") def start_launcher(self): launcher_bat = INSTALL_DIR / "PHS_Launcher.bat" subprocess.Popen( ["cmd", "/c", str(launcher_bat)], cwd=str(INSTALL_DIR), creationflags=subprocess.CREATE_NEW_CONSOLE )if __name__ == "__main__": app = Installer() app.mainloop()

4. payload 打包脚本
保存为：
tools/make_payload.py
作用：把 PHS 项目打成 phs_payload.zip。
Pythonimport osimport zipfilefrom pathlib import PathROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]OUT = ROOT / "dist" / "phs_payload.zip"INCLUDE_DIRS = [ "app", "_bundled", "runtime", "scripts", "docs", "_runtime",]INCLUDE_FILES = [ "README.md", "requirements.txt", "pyproject.toml",]EXCLUDE_NAMES = { "__pycache__", ".pytest_cache", ".git", ".venv", "venv", "dist", "build", "_archive", "_releases", "runs", "reports",}EXCLUDE_SUFFIXES = { ".pyc", ".pyo", ".log", ".tmp",}def should_skip(path: Path) -> bool: parts = set(path.parts) if parts & EXCLUDE_NAMES: return True if path.suffix.lower() in EXCLUDE_SUFFIXES: return True return Falsedef add_file(z: zipfile.ZipFile, file_path: Path): if should_skip(file_path): return arcname = file_path.relative_to(ROOT) z.write(file_path, arcname.as_posix())def main(): OUT.parent.mkdir(exist_ok=True) if OUT.exists(): OUT.unlink() print(f"[PHS] Creating payload: {OUT}") with zipfile.ZipFile(OUT, "w", compression=zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED, compresslevel=6) as z: launcher = ROOT / "launcher" / "PHS_Launcher.py" if not launcher.exists(): raise FileNotFoundError(f"Missing launcher: {launcher}") z.write(launcher, "PHS_Launcher.py") for d in INCLUDE_DIRS: p = ROOT / d if not p.exists(): print(f"[WARN] Missing dir, skipped: {p}") continue for file_path in p.rglob("*"): if file_path.is_file(): add_file(z, file_path) for f in INCLUDE_FILES: p = ROOT / f if p.exists(): add_file(z, p) size_mb = OUT.stat().st_size / 1024 / 1024 print(f"[PHS] Done. Payload size: {size_mb:.1f} MB")if __name__ == "__main__": main()

5. PyInstaller 打包脚本
保存为：
tools/build_setup.bat
bat@echo offsetlocalcd /d "%~dp0\.."echo [PHS] Step 1: Create payload zippython tools\make_payload.pyif errorlevel 1 goto failecho [PHS] Step 2: Install pyinstaller if missingpython -m pip show pyinstaller >nul 2>nulif errorlevel 1 ( python -m pip install pyinstaller)echo [PHS] Step 3: Build setup exepyinstaller ^ --onefile ^ --noconsole ^ --name PHS_Setup_v1.1.1 ^ --add-data "dist\phs_payload.zip;." ^ tools\phs_setup.pyif errorlevel 1 goto failecho.echo [PHS] Build OK:echo dist\PHS_Setup_v1.1.1.exeecho.pauseexit /b 0:failecho.echo [PHS] Build failed.pauseexit /b 1

6. 便携 Python 准备方式
在项目根目录放：
_runtime/python/python.exe
最简处理：
D:\PHS\_runtime\python\
里面必须包含：
python.exepython312.dllpython312.zip 或 Lib\DLLs\Lib\site-packages\
然后把 PHS 依赖安装进去。
如果你已经有可运行的 venv，不建议直接复制整个 .venv，但为了 v1.1.1 最简验证，可以临时这样做：
PowerShellcd D:\PHSmkdir _runtime\python# 更推荐使用官方 embeddable Python 或干净 Python 目录# 然后安装依赖到 _runtime/python/Lib/site-packages
如果你已经有一套能跑的 Python 3.12 环境，最小验证版可以先不做完美便携 Python，直接要求测试机也装 Python 3.12。
但为了“别人能装能跑”，我建议 v1.1.1 payload 里带 _runtime/python。

7. run_pipeline.py 参数建议
Launcher 里默认调用：
Bashpython app/material_engine/cli/run_pipeline.py --mode smokepython app/material_engine/cli/run_pipeline.py --mode full --input xxx --output runs/xxx
如果你当前 run_pipeline.py 还不支持这些参数，建议最低限度加这个兼容壳：
Python# app/material_engine/cli/run_pipeline.pyimport argparseimport sysfrom pathlib import Pathdef run_smoke(): print("[PHS] Running smoke pipeline...") # TODO: 接你现有 smoke 主逻辑 # 例如 import app.material_engine.cli.foundry_v10 as foundry # foundry.main_smoke() return 0def run_full(input_dir: str | None, output_dir: str | None): print("[PHS] Running full pipeline...") print(f"[PHS] input={input_dir}") print(f"[PHS] output={output_dir}") # TODO: 接你现有 full 主逻辑 return 0def main(): parser = argparse.ArgumentParser() parser.add_argument("--mode", choices=["smoke", "full"], default="smoke") parser.add_argument("--input", default=None) parser.add_argument("--output", default=None) args = parser.parse_args() if args.mode == "smoke": return run_smoke() if args.mode == "full": return run_full(args.input, args.output) return 1if __name__ == "__main__": raise SystemExit(main())

8. Doctor 最简 Python 版
如果你现在只有 PowerShell doctor，也可以保留。
但建议加一个 Python 版，方便 Launcher 调用。
保存为：
scripts/phs_doctor.py
Pythonimport osimport jsonimport shutilimport subprocessfrom pathlib import PathROOT = Path(os.environ.get("PHS_ROOT", Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]))FFMPEG = ROOT / "_bundled" / "ffmpeg" / "bin" / "ffmpeg.exe"FFPROBE = ROOT / "_bundled" / "ffmpeg" / "bin" / "ffprobe.exe"LIBVIPS_BIN = ROOT / "_bundled" / "libvips" / "bin"PIPER_MODELS = ROOT / "runtime" / "piper_models"RUN_PIPELINE = ROOT / "app" / "material_engine" / "cli" / "run_pipeline.py"REPORTS = ROOT / "reports"REPORTS.mkdir(exist_ok=True)def run_version(exe: Path, args: list[str]): if not exe.exists(): return None try: p = subprocess.run( [str(exe)] + args, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, text=True, encoding="utf-8", errors="replace", timeout=10, ) return p.stdout[:1000] except Exception as e: return f"ERROR: {e}"def check_obs(): possible = [ Path(os.environ.get("ProgramFiles", "")) / "obs-studio" / "bin" / "64bit" / "obs64.exe", Path(os.environ.get("ProgramFiles(x86)", "")) / "obs-studio" / "bin" / "64bit" / "obs64.exe", ] for p in possible: if p.exists(): return str(p) found = shutil.which("obs64.exe") return founddef main(): report = { "root": str(ROOT), "checks": { "ffmpeg_exists": FFMPEG.exists(), "ffprobe_exists": FFPROBE.exists(), "libvips_bin_exists": LIBVIPS_BIN.exists(), "piper_models_exists": PIPER_MODELS.exists(), "run_pipeline_exists": RUN_PIPELINE.exists(), "obs_detected": check_obs(), }, "versions": { "ffmpeg": run_version(FFMPEG, ["-version"]), "ffprobe": run_version(FFPROBE, ["-version"]), } } out = REPORTS / "phs_doctor_report.json" out.write_text(json.dumps(report, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding="utf-8") print(json.dumps(report, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)) print(f"\n[PHS] Doctor report saved: {out}") required = [ report["checks"]["ffmpeg_exists"], report["checks"]["ffprobe_exists"], report["checks"]["libvips_bin_exists"], report["checks"]["piper_models_exists"], report["checks"]["run_pipeline_exists"], ] return 0 if all(required) else 1if __name__ == "__main__": raise SystemExit(main())

9. 使用流程
第一步：准备目录
D:\PHS\ app\ _bundled\ runtime\ scripts\ launcher\ tools\ _runtime\
确认：
D:\PHS\_bundled\ffmpeg\bin\ffmpeg.exeD:\PHS\_bundled\ffmpeg\bin\ffprobe.exeD:\PHS\_bundled\libvips\bin\D:\PHS\runtime\piper_models\D:\PHS\_runtime\python\python.exeD:\PHS\launcher\PHS_Launcher.py

第二步：构建安装器
batcd /d D:\PHStools\build_setup.bat

D:\PHS\dist\PHS_Setup_v1.1.1.exe

第三步：测试安装
在测试机或干净目录双击：
PHS_Setup_v1.1.1.exe

%LOCALAPPDATA%\PrismHopeStudio\
桌面会出现：
PHS Launcher.bat

10. v1.1.1 验收标准
这个方案只验收 7 件事：
1. PHS_Setup_v1.1.1.exe 可双击运行2. 能解压到 %LOCALAPPDATA%\PrismHopeStudio3. 桌面生成 PHS Launcher.bat4. Launcher 能打开5. Doctor 能检测 FFmpeg / libvips / Piper / OBS6. Smoke 能运行7. OBS 未安装时不崩溃，只提示用户安装

11. 不做的事
v1.1.1 明确不做：
不做代码签名不做注册表复杂安装不做服务安装不做自动更新不做卸载器不做 NSIS / WiX / MSI 复杂工程不做驱动安装不自动安装 OBS不自动安装虚拟声卡不做商业安装包体验
原因：
当前目标是“别人能装能跑”，不是商业发布。

12. 最终建议
最简可行版本就是：
PHS_Setup_v1.1.1.exe= PyInstaller 打包的 phs_setup.py+ phs_payload.zip+ 便携 Python+ PHS Launcher+ Doctor+ Smoke
这条路线够简单、够快、够稳。
先把它跑通，再考虑后面是否换 NSIS / Inno Setup / MSI。
